title: Lattice recovery of an inversive congruential generator with an unknown coefficient
summary: Determine whether the source MIHNP lattice technique recovers an inversive congruential generator when coefficient $a$ or $b$ is unknown.

formal_statement.body: For the source leakage model and inversive congruential recurrence $v_{i+1}=a v_i^{-1}+b\pmod p$, establish, separately for (i) unknown $a$ with known $b$ and (ii) unknown $b$ with known $a$, a polynomial-time lattice recovery attack with explicit leakage, sample, success-probability, and complexity bounds, or prove that the source technique cannot extend under those assumptions.

scope.domain: Algebraic cryptanalysis of inversive congruential generators with partial output leakage
assumptions: The recurrence and leakage model are those of the TIT source
Exactly one of $a$ or $b$ is unknown
The goal is recovery of the hidden state or unknown generator parameter
scope.unresolved_remainder: Neither the unknown-$a nor unknown-$b instance has a source-compatible lattice recovery theorem or impossibility result after the 2023 statement.

progress.summary: The source explicitly asks whether its technique can solve the two unknown-coefficient ICG cases.
